note: Starting points only. Classes are TeeJet's published ISO 25358 / ASABE S572 water-spray classes for AITXA/AITXB-VK ceramic air-induction hollow-cone tips (air-blast); the pressure range is the span where that chart lists the stated class or coarser for the size. Colors are the ISO 10625 colors for the size code (as printed on Albuz ATI orchard hollow-cone tips). Confirm with your nozzle chart and the product label.
